d1.title: Introduction to Search Engines
d1.text: Search engines are complex systems that retrieve information from the web. They use crawlers to discover pages and indexes to store content for fast retrieval.

d2.title: Web Crawling Fundamentals
d2.text: Web crawlers systematically browse the internet following hyperlinks from page to page. Crawling strategies include breadth first and depth first traversal of the link graph.

d3.title: Indexing Techniques
d3.text: Inverted indexes map terms to the documents containing them. Index construction involves tokenization and term weighting to enable efficient lookup during query processing.

d4.title: PageRank Algorithm
d4.text: PageRank assigns importance scores to web pages based on the link structure of the web. Pages with many incoming links from important pages receive higher scores.

d5.title: HITS Algorithm
d5.text: The HITS algorithm identifies hub and authority pages. Authorities are pages with valuable content that many hubs point to. Hubs are pages that link to many good authorities.

d6.title: Link Analysis Overview
d6.text: Link analysis uses the hyperlink structure of the web to assess page quality. Both PageRank and HITS are foundational algorithms in web information retrieval.

d7.title: Query Processing
d7.text: Query processing involves parsing user queries matching terms against the index and ranking results. Boolean and vector space models are common retrieval frameworks.

d8.title: Relevance Ranking
d8.text: Relevance ranking combines content based scores with link based authority signals. Modern search engines blend multiple ranking factors to produce the final result list.

d9.title: Web Graph Properties
d9.text: The web graph exhibits power law degree distributions with a few highly connected hub pages. The structure reveals communities and clusters of topically related pages.

d10.title: Evaluation of Search
d10.text: Search quality is measured using precision recall and mean average precision. Test collections with relevance judgments enable systematic evaluation of retrieval systems.
